name: task_integrate
description: Acknowledge durable results after incorporation or explicit rejection. Integrate every delivered task_id before a normal final answer. The parent owns acceptance; accepted results with structured verification gaps get post-integration advice. Missing verification never rejects legacy results or changes atomic batches.

task_id.description: Non-empty delivered task ID, copied verbatim from task_wait/task_status's `[task_id=...]` header or task_spawn/task_audit/task_retry's `task_id=`/`new_task_id=` field.

disposition.description: Parent disposition: accepted = incorporated; rejected = reviewed, deliberately unused; superseded = replaced by a newer attempt or result.

summary.description: Parent conclusion and effect on remaining work; non-empty, at most 6000 characters.
